basics.type: Private university, set up under the UPES Act, 2003 of Uttarakhand
basics.ugc: Recognised under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.campus: Two campuses in Dehradun: Bidholi (engineering, computer science, design, health sciences) and Kandoli (law, business, media, liberal studies)
basics.other: Law programmes recognised by the Bar Council of India; pharmacy programmes by the Pharmacy Council of India; selected B.Tech and MBA programmes accredited by NBA

admission: 50% in Class X and XII, with 50% in PCM
UPESEAT, JEE Main, board merit, SAT or CUET-UG. Up to 20% of seats go through JEE Main and board merit.
UPESMET-UG, UGAT, CUET or board marks
ULSAT, CLAT, board merit or CUET
50% in Class X and XII, any stream
UPESDAT or NID, NIFT, UCEED, JEE Main, board merit or CUET-UG, then portfolio and interview
50% in Class X and XII with PCB/PCM and English
UPESPAT, JEE Main, board merit, NEET or CUET

scholarships.text: Merit scholarships on tuition fee: 10% to 30% based on Class 12 marks (30% for 95.01% and above). National exam scholarships go up to 100% (for example, JEE Main percentile 95.01 and above).

hostel.text: Separate hostels for boys and girls on both the Bidholi and Kandoli campuses, with meals.

fees.text: UPES publishes programme-wise, semester-wise fees on its fee structure page.
